### `fhe.alloc` (aegis::fhe::AllocOp)

_Allocation ciphertext operation on heap memory_


Syntax:

```
operation ::= `fhe.alloc` `(` operands `)` attr-dict `:`  `(` type(operands) `)` `->` type(results)
```

The `alloc` operation allocates a region of memory, as specified by its memref type.

Example:
  ```mlir
  %0 = fhe.alloc() : !Fhe.LWEChiperVector<64xi32>
  ```

Traits: `AlwaysSpeculatableImplTrait`

Interfaces: `ConditionallySpeculatable`, `NoMemoryEffect (MemoryEffectOpInterface)`

Effects: `MemoryEffects::Effect{}`

| :----: | ----------- |
| `output` | int or f64 or f64vector or plain or plainvector or lwecipher or lweciphervec or lweciphermat or rlwecipher or rlweciphermat

### `fhe.alloca` (aegis::fhe::AllocaOp)

_Allocation ciphertext operation on stack memory_


Syntax:

```
operation ::= `fhe.alloca` `(` operands `)` attr-dict `:`  `(` type(operands) `)` `->` type(results)
```

The `alloca` operation allocates memory on the stack, to be automatically released.

  %0 = fhe.alloca() : !Fhe.LWEChiperVector<64xi32>
